pages: Foreground: Nemi, fifteen, dark hair cut level at the jaw and tied back, a red wool jersey with the sleeves pushed up, worn rubber boots, one hand on the wet stone sill. Middle: the low sluice, one gate, water folding white over it. Background: a mill wheel, willows, roofs. Light: long June evening light off the water.

Nemi, a girl of fifteen with dark hair cut level at the jaw and tied back, in a red wool jersey with the sleeves pushed up, standing waist-deep in a drainage ditch cut along a river bank, one hand on a long wooden pole. Middle: cut grass on the ditch lip, a scuffed bucket on the bank. Background: a weir, a low meadow, reeds, hard afternoon sun.

Foreground: a gauge board with marked notches, its lower edge wet. Middle: Nemi, fifteen, dark hair cut level at the jaw and tied back, a red wool jersey with the sleeves pushed up, worn rubber boots, one finger on the water line stained into the sluice wall. Background: sallows over the weir, swifts above them. Light: flat white midday light.

Foreground: three clothbound books squared on a kitchen table, a brass folding rule beside them. Middle: Wynn, her grandfather, old, a flat cap, weathered, writing an evening figure with a pencil. Background: a kitchen window, a brown coat on a nail. Light: one lamp on the table.

Foreground: Nemi, fifteen, dark hair cut level at the jaw and tied back, a red wool jersey with the sleeves pushed up, worn rubber boots, sitting at a schoolroom desk, hands flat on the wood. Middle: rows of chairs, a folded sheet in front of her. Background: a plain wall, a high window. Light: June light through the windows.

Foreground: a schoolroom table with an open ledger and a pen across it. Middle: Nemi, fifteen, dark hair cut level at the jaw and tied back, a red wool jersey with the sleeves pushed up, worn rubber boots, standing with both hands on its edge. Background: three chairs, a map board. Light: dull light from one window.

Foreground: water coming over the sill of the sluice in one lip. Middle: Nemi, fifteen, dark hair cut level at the jaw and tied back, a red wool jersey with the sleeves pushed up, worn rubber boots, standing on the bank above the gate. Background: the Ings green to the far hedge, sallows. Light: evening sun low down the river.

Foreground: Wynn, her grandfather, old, a flat cap, weathered, both hands flat on a sheet of paper on a kitchen table. Middle: a brown coat with the right sleeve patched over a chair back. Background: a window, a stone sink. Light: grey window light on the table.

Foreground: a scuffed wooden bucket on the sill, a knotted measuring string with a stone in the water. Middle: Nemi, fifteen, dark hair cut level at the jaw and tied back, a red wool jersey with the sleeves pushed up, worn rubber boots, reading marks on the string. Background: the gatepost with a chest of chalk figures. Light: low sun.

Foreground: the gatepost with a chest of chalk figures, a hand holding out a folding rule towards them. Middle: Fen, twenty-four, a water-company engineer, short hair, a pale shirt, a shoulder bag, a permit book under his arm. Background: the sluice house door, the scuffed wooden bucket. Light: evening light, long shadows.

Foreground: an open permit book on the gatepost, a pencil laid in the gutter of the page. Middle: Fen, twenty-four, a water-company engineer, short hair, a pale shirt, a shoulder bag, writing with his wrist braced on the chalk marks. Background: water over the sill, reeds. Light: flat evening light, no wind.

Foreground: Nemi, fifteen, dark hair cut level at the jaw and tied back, a red wool jersey with the sleeves pushed up, worn rubber boots, one hand held out over the water of a mill pool. Middle: the old channel running under the road through a stone arch. Background: willows for half a mile, the sluice. Light: afternoon sun.

Foreground: nettles and long grass over ground where water runs out of sight. Middle: Nemi, fifteen, dark hair cut level at the jaw and tied back, a red wool jersey with the sleeves pushed up, worn rubber boots, standing with one hand on a willow trunk. Background: the line of willows, the road above. Light: green shade under the trees.

Foreground: a sheet of stiff paper on a kitchen table, a pencil and dividers across it. Middle: Nemi, fifteen, dark hair cut level at the jaw and tied back, a red wool jersey with the sleeves pushed up, worn rubber boots, leaning over the table working. Background: a window streaming with rain, three books stacked. Light: a bare bulb overhead.

Foreground: a knotted measuring string and its stone hanging slack, water low against the sill. Middle: Nemi, fifteen, dark hair cut level at the jaw and tied back, a red wool jersey with the sleeves pushed up, worn rubber boots, crouched with her eye level with the stone. Background: dry meadow, standing reeds, a gravel bar. Light: hard August light.

Foreground: three clothbound books open on a kitchen table, one page crowded with figures in a shaky hand. Middle: Wynn, her grandfather, old, a flat cap, weathered, one finger on a line in the top book. Background: shelves, a hanging brown coat. Light: daylight across the pages.

A schoolroom table cleared of everything but an inkwell and one pen. Middle: a chair pushed back, a heap of paper on the desk behind it. Background: rows of chairs, a window with the light going out of it. Nobody in the picture. Light: late light, the room empty.

Foreground: three clothbound books laid in a row on a long schoolroom table, a hand flat on the top one. Middle: Wynn, her grandfather, old, a flat cap, weathered, standing on the far side. Background: rows of empty chairs, a plain wall. Light: flat window light.

Foreground: worn rubber boots on a cobbled lane, one heel lifted. Middle: Nemi, fifteen, dark hair cut level at the jaw and tied back, a red wool jersey with the sleeves pushed up, worn rubber boots, walking with her hands in her jersey pockets. Background: the schoolroom wall, a gate, a hedge. Light: low evening sun down the lane.

Nemi, a girl of fifteen with dark hair cut level at the jaw and tied back, in a red wool jersey, seated at a kitchen table with a pen in her right hand over a single sheet of paper, her left hand flat on the table. Middle: a window behind her, a stone sink, a chair. Background: a whitewashed wall. Steady daylight from the window on the paper and her hands.

Foreground: an opened envelope on a table, a sheet folded in three. Middle: Nemi, fifteen, dark hair cut level at the jaw and tied back, a red wool jersey with the sleeves pushed up, worn rubber boots, holding the sheet in both hands. Background: a stone sink, a coat on a hook. Light: flat morning light through the window.

Foreground: a sheet held in one hand, a bicycle's front wheel and pedal below it. Middle: Fen, twenty-four, a water-company engineer, short hair, a pale shirt, a shoulder bag, standing beside the bicycle. Background: a yard wall, a gate, a scuffed wooden bucket. Light: low September sun.

A scuffed wooden bucket on a gatepost ledge beside a chest of chalk figures. Middle: the Ings cut, hay standing in rows, water over the sill. Background: a mill wheel turning, a gravel bar, reeds. Nobody in the picture. Light: bright hard morning light.

Foreground: a brass folding rule opened in a weathered hand, its arm laid over the sill. Middle: Wynn, her grandfather, old, a flat cap, weathered, bent over the water at the sluice. Background: the gatepost with its chest of chalk figures, the scuffed bucket. Light: six o'clock sun, low and orange.

Foreground: the gatepost with a chest of chalk figures, the topmost one higher and clearer than the rest. Middle: water over the sill into the meadow, a shut book on the ledge. Background: a path up the bank, reeds, a mill wheel. Nobody in the picture. Light: the last evening light, flat and gold.

Foreground: Ivo, fifteen, short dark hair, a pale scraped face, a bright orange oilskin coat with a wet shine across the shoulders, in the doorway of a ferry hut. Middle: two flat-bottomed boats moored to a slip, one lamp on a bow. Background: thick fog on black water. Light: the bow lamp, an orange smear on the water.

Foreground: a steel chain round a winch on a flat deck. Middle: Ivo, fifteen, short dark hair, a pale scraped face, a bright orange oilskin coat with a wet shine across the shoulders, at the bow lamp of the second boat. Background: the first boat moored behind, fog with no edge. Light: one lamp, its beam lost at ten feet.

Foreground: a clothbound fare book open on the wheelhouse shelf, a green coin beside it. Middle: Ivo, fifteen, short dark hair, a pale scraped face, a bright orange oilskin coat with a wet shine across the shoulders, turning a page. Background: spare fuses on a shelf, a fogged window. Light: the bow lamp across the page.

Foreground: an open hand held out flat, one coin in the middle of the palm. Middle: Ivo, fifteen, short dark hair, a pale scraped face, a bright orange oilskin coat with a wet shine across the shoulders, standing square in the bow. Background: the chain, the slip, fog going past. Light: the bow lamp straight down on the coin.

A hand hanging over the side of a thwart, fingers loose, a cap pulled over closed eyes. Middle: the one passenger asleep with his back to the wheel, boots flat on the boards. Background: the wheel and its spokes, fog. Light: low lamp light across his knees.

Foreground: two knuckles raised against the flat top of a wooden thwart. Middle: Ivo, fifteen, short dark hair, a pale scraped face, a bright orange oilskin coat with a wet shine across the shoulders, arm cocked, waiting. Background: fog going past the hull, the wheelhouse light behind. Light: the wheelhouse lamp on the knuckles, black water beyond.

Foreground: a mooring chain in a hand, water working round a bollard. Middle: Marek, the ferry master, fifty, grey, a heavy coat, sitting on the bollard with his eyes shut and his hat brim down. Background: the slip, a flat boat bow, fog. Light: one orange thumbprint of light with no arm on it.

Foreground: boots on a steel deck, water walking at the bow. Middle: Ivo, fifteen, short dark hair, a pale scraped face, a bright orange oilskin coat with a wet shine across the shoulders, leaning on the bow rail. Background: fog with no far bank in it, a single orange light far off. Light: that one light, everything else grey.

Foreground: a hand on a chain and a boot finding the top step of a slip. Middle: a woman of forty-five, grey hair cut square at the jaw, a coat fastened to the top, coming down the slip and standing on the boards. Background: fog, the boat's rail, black water. Light: an orange thumbprint of light on the wet boards.

Foreground: a green coin lying in an open palm, a small boat raised on its face. Middle: Ivo, fifteen, short dark hair, a pale scraped face, a bright orange oilskin coat with a wet shine across the shoulders, looking down at it. Background: the fare book open on the thwart. Light: the bow lamp on the coin, the palm bright.

Foreground: the fare book open on the thwart, a ruled column with nothing in it. Middle: Ivo, fifteen, short dark hair, a pale scraped face, a bright orange oilskin coat with a wet shine across the shoulders, one finger on the page. Background: the chain across the bow, the wheel, fog. Light: lamp light down the spine of the book.

Foreground: a worn tiller bar gripped in two hands, hard over. Middle: Ivo, fifteen, short dark hair, a pale scraped face, a bright orange oilskin coat with a wet shine across the shoulders, braced at the tiller, one hand going to a pocket. Background: the deck, the wheel, fog. Light: the bow lamp, white water crossing the bow.

Foreground: two boots flat on the boards, one hand lying along a gunwale. Middle: a woman of forty-five, grey hair cut square at the jaw, a coat fastened to the top, sitting square to the side amidships. Background: the empty thwart, fog going past. Light: a lantern standing on the thwart beside her.

Foreground: two fingers laid on the front corner of a thwart, on a worn bright place in the varnish. Middle: a woman of forty-five, grey hair cut square at the jaw, a coat fastened to the top, sitting amidships with her arm up. Background: a row of thwarts, the gunwale, fog. Light: the lantern low and steady.

Foreground: the tiller bar changing hands, a boot on the deck. Middle: Marek, the ferry master, fifty, grey, a heavy coat, standing at the tiller. Background: a mid-river post with one lamp, fog closing round it. Light: the post's lamp small and steady, the bow lamp behind.

Foreground: two hands on a pair of knees, a sleeve dark with spray. Middle: Marek, the ferry master, fifty, grey, a heavy coat, sitting up on the bollard with his eyes just open. Background: the slip, the chain, fog. Light: the boat's lantern across one side of his face.

Foreground: two boots on the boards of a slip, water sliding under them. Middle: a woman of forty-five, grey hair cut square at the jaw, a coat fastened to the top, standing facing the boat. Background: the hull alongside, the bow lamp, fog. Light: the lantern on her coat, black water behind.

Foreground: a hand lifted off a knee and held out flat. Middle: Marek, the ferry master, fifty, grey, a heavy coat, still on the bollard. Background: the deck of the boat, the lamp, the slip in fog. Light: the lantern across the boards, the far light a blur.

Foreground: the tiller bar and a boy's hand laid flat along it. Middle: Ivo, fifteen, short dark hair, a pale scraped face, a bright orange oilskin coat with a wet shine across the shoulders, standing in front of the thwart. Background: fog going past, the gunwale. Light: the bow lamp from behind his shoulder.

Foreground: two hands pushed into coat pockets and boots on a plank lane. Middle: a woman of forty-five, grey hair cut square at the jaw, a coat fastened to the top, walking away up the lane with her head down. Background: the slip, a lit boat behind, hedges. Light: the boat's lamp thrown back up the lane.

Foreground: the fare book open on a table with a small pencil mark in the margin and a tin of coins beside it. Middle: Ivo, fifteen, short dark hair, a pale scraped face, a bright orange oilskin coat with a wet shine across the shoulders, writing. Background: fuses on a string, a wheelhouse shelf. Light: one lamp on the table.

Foreground: a heavy chain in a hand, water running up the boards and back. Middle: Marek, the ferry master, fifty, grey, a heavy coat, standing on the slip at the post. Background: a flat boat bow, the bollard, fog. Light: one orange light on the wet boards.

Foreground: a tin of coins on a table, a thumb resting beside a small pencil mark on an open page. Middle: Marek, the ferry master, fifty, grey, a heavy coat, turning the tin with one finger. Background: a lamp on the table, a fogged window. Light: the table lamp straight down on the tin.

Foreground: a hand sliding a tin back under a thwart, string and fuses beside it. Middle: Ivo, fifteen, short dark hair, a pale scraped face, a bright orange oilskin coat with a wet shine across the shoulders, crouched under the seat. Background: the bow, a slack chain, fog on the water. Light: one orange light, the boards wet and dark.
